precision: Original BF16 weights, including every original bit in the lossless cache; FP32 activations, products, sums and softmax. RMSNorm uses parallel FP32 reduction.

0.8b.text: Translation quality depends on context, terminology, and the structure of the original document. limits: Throughput uses 81 prompt tokens and 24 output tokens (23 decode steps), with a two-token warmup and three measured requests. Before/after preserve exactly the same original working matrices; 8B uses the same lossless representation on both sides. Cache ceilings differ but neither throughput worker performs explicit projection reads during measured requests. Startup is measured separately with no warmup and includes cache/GPU preparations before readiness; its 8B baseline retains fewer weights and also has different available memory. The cache-packing run predates full GPU decode and has unequal raw/packed cache budgets. Numerical checks cover short/long prompts and six completed 2B translations, not a broad quality study. 31B real inference is not measured.
